subject: Coupa invite shows expired when vendor clicks — timezone header issue
messages:
From: Natalie Gomez <natalie.gomez@albacollective.com>

Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, accounts@albacollective.com
Date: 2027-05-14T17:05:00-04:00
Subject: Cannot accept Coupa invite — link already expired

Hi Soojin,

We tried to complete the supplier onboarding link you sent this morning (appears to be a Coupa invite). The email says the invite is valid for 7 days but when I click the link I get an "Invite expired" page. I've attached a screenshot and a small packet capture from my browser (screenshot_inv_expired.png).

We attempted from both desktop (Chrome 102 on macOS) and mobile (iOS 16 Safari) and get the same result. Our finance team is blocked — we need to confirm our legal entity and bank details so PO processing can continue.

Can you please reissue the invite or tell us a workaround? If needed we can accept POs by signed PDF while this gets sorted but that's manual.

Thanks,
Natalie Gomez
Vendor Operations Lead
Alba Collective
+natalie.gomez@albacollective.com

Hi Natalie — thanks for the heads up and the screenshot. Sorry for the friction.

Quick questions so I can escalate efficiently to Coupa support:
- Can you paste the full invite URL (just the link, we won't share it outside support).
- Did you try opening the link from an incognito window?
- Roughly what time did you click the link (timezone aware)?

Next steps from our side: I will open a ticket with Coupa and include your logs. If this prevents you from receiving POs today we can accept the PO over email as you suggested — please send the invoice/confirmed PO PDF to accounts@albacollective.com and cc me; we will mark it for manual processing until the portal is fixed.

I'll also include a small click log from our side (coupa_click_log.txt) — attaching.

Thanks,

From: Coupa Support <support@coupa.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Natalie Gomez <natalie.gomez@albacollective.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-15T02:45:00+00:00
Subject: RE: Coupa invite error — ticket INV-983274

Hi Soojin and Natalie,

Thanks for the debug artifacts. We investigated INV-983274 and reproduced the behavior. Root cause: a proxy in front of our OAuth endpoint was injecting a local timezone header that caused our invite expiry calculation to compare local time incorrectly, resulting in an invite being treated as already expired for certain client timezones.

Workaround/Resolution: We've invalidated the affected token and reissued a fresh invite with an explicit expiry encoded in UTC. The new invite ID is INV-983274-R2. Please try accepting within the next 72 hours.

If the vendor still cannot accept we can temporarily enable a one-time accept link tied to the vendor email (requires action from Coupa Ops). We have also created a short-term mitigation so timestamps are normalized to UTC for links issued from our EU/TZ edge.

Link (reissued): https://supplier.coupa.com/invite/INV-983274-R2
Support ticket: https://coupa.support/tickets/INV-983274

Regards,
Amit Shah
Technical Support Engineer — Coupa
support@coupa.com

Subject: RE: Coupa invite shows expired when vendor clicks — timezone header issue

Hi Natalie — Coupa confirmed the issue and reissued a new invite. I have resent the invite from the platform this morning. Action items for you:
1) Please click the new invite here: https://supplier.coupa.com/invite/INV-983274-R2 (expires in 72 hours UTC).
2) If you still hit any error, try an incognito browser and send me the exact error page screenshot.
3) As a backup, you can email the signed PO/invoice PDF to accounts@albacollective.com and cc me; we will do a one-off manual acceptance while Coupa enables the one-time accept link.

I've also asked our internal billing ops (cc Diego) to watch for any incoming PDFs so we don't miss a PO. Marcus — please update the onboarding checklist once Natalie confirms.

Thanks again for the quick response and apologies for the interruption.

Best,
Soojin
